title: B2B Site Studio Local Agent Job
description: Safe, reproducible, versioned job contract for the local Windows Codex agent.

workspaceId.description: Logical workspace key resolved by the local agent from protected local configuration. The server never sends absolute local paths.

networkAllowlist.description: Typed outbound network destinations. Arbitrary host strings from user text are not valid destinations.

untrustedRepositoryCode.description: Repository code, package scripts, npm lifecycle scripts, and generated files are treated as untrusted and run only inside the sandbox.

payload.description: Structured data. This field is never executed directly as shell.

allowedCapabilities.description: Deny-by-default. A missing capability is forbidden.

allowedActions.description: Deny-by-default. A missing action is forbidden even when not listed in forbiddenActions.

identifier.description: Stable repository identity checked before git writes.

originUrl.description: Expected git origin. Agent must verify the local checkout remote matches this value before committing or pushing.

sha256.description: Null before creation; filled by the agent after artifact creation and verified during artifact completion.

posixRelativePath.description: Normalized POSIX-relative concrete path. Agent must resolve and realpath-check containment after symlink/junction/reparse resolution.

posixRelativeGlob.description: Normalized POSIX-relative glob. Only POSIX slash separators are accepted; realpath containment is still required for matched files.

x-semanticValidation: GitHub network destinations used for git_push_feature_branch and create_or_update_pull_request must bind to repository.identifier, repository.providerRepositoryId, repository.originUrl, and gitWorkflow.targetBranch.
GitHub writes must target codex/ branches only; main, master, force-push, and merge are never allowed by this job contract.
Network destinations are selected from typed allowlist entries only. Arbitrary hostnames or URLs copied from user text are not valid execution targets.
Artifact upload is allowed only through an artifact_upload destination with a stable artifactTargetId.
WordPress staging and production actions must use matching wordpress_staging or wordpress_production destinations and target IDs from protected server-side configuration.

instructions.displaySummary: Create one safe test file in the sandbox folder.
instructions.objective: Verify that the local agent can write an allowed artifact without touching project or production files.
steps: Write a short non-secret status line.
Do not modify files outside the sandbox folder.
acceptanceCriteria: The file exists inside the allowed sandbox path.

instructions.displaySummary: Create an executable HTML/CSS design-reference prototype without publishing.
instructions.objective: Generate one prototype variant for a B2B wholesale catalog so the user can compare visual directions before WordPress implementation.
steps: Capture a screenshot artifact if the local browser_screenshot capability is available.
Do not publish, deploy, install packages, or change production configuration.
acceptanceCriteria: No external secrets or real personal data are embedded.

x-negativeExamples.name: windows_absolute_path_rejected
x-negativeExamples.expectedReason: paths must be normalized POSIX-relative paths inside allowed project scopes

x-negativeExamples.name: unc_path_rejected
x-negativeExamples.expectedReason: UNC paths are forbidden; only normalized POSIX-relative paths are allowed

x-negativeExamples.name: traversal_path_rejected
x-negativeExamples.expectedReason: path traversal outside the workspace is rejected before execution

x-negativeExamples.name: self_approved_irreversible_action_rejected
x-negativeExamples.expectedReason: irreversible actions require human approval and cannot be self-approved by the executor

x-negativeExamples.name: github_push_with_network_disabled
x-negativeExamples.expectedReason: git push requires allowlisted network access and a github_git destination

instructions.objective: Must reject push when network is disabled.

x-negativeExamples.name: github_push_without_allowlisted_destination
x-negativeExamples.expectedReason: git push requires a github_git allowlist entry bound to the repository and target branch

instructions.objective: Must reject push without github_git destination.

x-negativeExamples.name: github_push_to_non_codex_branch
x-negativeExamples.expectedReason: git push targetBranch must stay under the codex/ branch prefix

x-negativeExamples.name: pull_request_without_github_api_destination
x-negativeExamples.expectedReason: pull request creation requires an allowlisted github_api destination

instructions.objective: Must reject PR update without github_api destination.

x-semanticNegativeExamples.name: mismatched_repository_origin
x-semanticNegativeExamples.expectedReason: GitHub network allowlist binding must match repository originUrl and target branch

x-semanticNegativeExamples.name: action_without_capability
x-semanticNegativeExamples.expectedReason: each allowed action must have the corresponding capability

x-semanticNegativeExamples.name: validation_action_without_capability
x-semanticNegativeExamples.expectedReason: run_registered_validation requires the base codex capability

instructions.objective: Must reject registered validation without codex capability.

x-semanticNegativeExamples.name: invalid_git_ref_lock_suffix
x-semanticNegativeExamples.expectedReason: targetBranch must pass the safe git ref policy, including .lock segment rejection

x-semanticNegativeExamples.name: invalid_git_ref_hidden_segment

instructions.objective: Must reject git ref segment beginning with dot.

x-semanticNegativeExamples.name: staging_action_with_production_destination

instructions.objective: Must reject production target for staging action.

x-semanticNegativeExamples.name: unexpected_network_host
x-semanticNegativeExamples.expectedReason: structured execution target host in payload must be represented by a typed allowlist destination
